text:
Into the house of day come people and things,

foul-smelling weeds, sleepless horses,

airs with music, mannequins just like girls;

in come you, Tarumba, and I.

In comes dance. In comes the sun. A life insurance agent

and a Poet.

A policeman.

We're all going to sell ourselves, Tarumba.

translation.title: Into the House of Day
